article.story: MURFREESBORO, Tenn -- — Quintero Barnett had 18 points in Middle Tennessee's 73-68 victory over Evansville on Tuesday. Barnett added six rebounds for the Blue Raiders (2-1). Jahvin Carter scored 14 points and added five assists. Marcus Whitlock shot 4 for 8 and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points, while adding eight rebounds. Bryce Quinet led the Purple Aces (2-1) in scoring, finishing with 19 points, seven assists and three steals. Evansville also got 18 points from Max Langenfeld. Middle Tennessee went into halftime ahead of Evansville 27-20. Barnett scored 10 points in the half. Middle Tennessee used a 7-0 second-half run to erase a two-point deficit and take the lead at 43-38 with 11:08 left in the half before finishing off the victory. Whitlock scored 11 second-half points. Up next Middle Tennessee's next game is Friday against Southeast Missouri State at home. Evansville hosts Miami (OH) on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
